property_summary: For any recipient whose fallback reverts, C's getFirstWithdrawalBonus will revert (because withdrawReward tries to send and require(success)), while the mutant that removed the withdraw will NOT revert and will mark claimedBonus true — so there exist recipients (reverting contracts) for which reference reverts but mutant succeeds.
change_summary: Remove the call to withdrawReward so the bonus is only recorded in rewardsForA and not withdrawn during this call.
